decisionDateBasis: SZSE September calendar and observed Sina daily bar; source publication timestamp and full-market publication remain unverified. Never advance D automatically.

purposes.research-diagnostic: Explicit proxy/missing/imputed/unverified quality and original denominators required; no strategy promotion.
purposes.strategy-validation: Consumed data must be independently verified and PIT; metadata/hash validation alone is insufficient.

history.warmupBasis: LTRSTR/LTHALPHA: 1040 observations + 273 skip + 11 smoothing + 252 risk-regression days. Annual changes over five years require six reports available before first exposure.
history.shorterHistoryPolicy: blocked; record actual coverage, never shorten the registered target silently

universes.U_all: Effective-dated SSE/SZSE/BSE ordinary A shares including historical delistings, ST, IPO and suspensions; exclude ETF/fund/bond/convertible by recorded instrument type, not today's list.
universes.U_eligible: U_all after 252 exchange trading days listed; exclude ST for new purchases, suspended/non-buyable securities and unsupported effective-dated order rules. Keep each exclusion in U_all.
universes.U_model: U_all with verified risk inputs; missing exposures remain missing and count against original eligible denominator.
universes.U_research: Ex-ante scored subset with evidence; missing research is not a zero score and does not change ranks of the scored pool.
universes.U_hold: All confirmed holdings including excluded, frozen, odd-lot and delisted positions; never drop for missing score or model.
universes.U_benchmark: Complete effective-dated CSI300 or CSI800 constituents/weights; never filter to candidates or renormalize after omissions.

resources.retryPolicy: No same-run retry; a separately registered retry may select only failed partitions after root-cause review. No proxy rotation or bypass.

timeContract.live: availableAt >= max(all input sourceAvailableAt, input firstFetchedAt/revisionFetchedAt, generatedAt, publishedAt)
timeContract.retrospective: sourceAvailableAt <= simulationAsOf; preserve original document/version; reconstructedAt is actual computation time, never backdate generatedAt/firstFetchedAt
timeContract.unknown: null plus reason; never guess May 1, use report end as availability, or equate fetchedAt with first publication

publicationPolicy.revisionPolicy: New immutable publication per correction, keep old inputs/results; candidate failure must not change CURRENT; no formal promotion from a caller-supplied pass flag.
publicationPolicy.legacyPolicy: Existing CNE6 CURRENT is a diagnostic artifact, not an A2-approved strategy publication. This contract does not relabel it.
